boundaries.evidence: The Statement includes the empty quiver; the sums in step 1.1 are zero and step 2.1 has the identity zero-rank quotient.
Zero coordinates give point Grassmannians and zero-rank blocks; step 3.1 handles these cases.
The rank formula in step 1.1 applies to a one-arrow quiver without a separate genericity assumption.
The endpoint Grassmannians for a_i=0 or a_i=a_i+b_i are points, explicitly handled in step 3.1.
Subobject endpoints a_i=0 and a_i=a_i+b_i are included in step 3.1.

AC is explicit in the Statement and A1. Steps 1.1–2.1 inherit it through the quotient, affine descent, smoothness and additive-torsor suppliers as well as the projective properness suppliers; local block calculations introduce no further choice.
